mapper.update: MERGE INTO content_translation target USING ( SELECT #{sourceType} AS source_type, #{sourceKey} AS source_key, #{sourceField} AS source_field, #{targetLanguage} AS target_language, #{sourceHash} AS source_hash FROM dual ) source ON (target.source_type = source.source_type AND target.source_key = source.source_key AND target.source_field = source.source_field AND target.target_language = source.target_language) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (source_type, source_key, source_field, target_language, source_hash, status, failure_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (source.source_type, source.source_key, source.source_field, source.target_language, source.source_hash, 'IDLE', 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
